description: Delegated identities for agents: scoped, repo-bound, short-lived credentials with a full allow/deny usage log.
notes: Shared kit landed mid-build; re-targeted to the real shared/kit.js contract.

notes.note: Least-privilege, expiring, auditable agent credentials is the right product at the right time, and identity is genuinely sticky — whoever mints owns the audit trail. Weakest assumption: enterprises buy identity from platforms (Okta/WorkOS), not point startups, so the wedge has to be agent-specific depth the platforms can't be bothered with. Nobody sends an identity layer to a coworker, but CISOs buy it anyway.
Issue-credential increments active count (1->2), uses logged; zero errors.

notes.change: Hero CTA 'Watch the attack drill' animates a fresh 3-attack denial sequence (prod deploy, Stripe key, branch rules) with flash-highlighted DENIED rows; magic moment is now on-demand, not buried in the feed.
